frozen: 2026-10-14, before any metric, instruction count or timing was collected; committed on its own ahead of the results
question: At n = 131 (the ECC2K-130 field size), what does exact normal-basis least-rotation canonicalization cost in a three-limb word for (a) the exhaustive scan, (b) the zero-gap set-bit scan (variant B analogue), and (c) a branch-free version, in deterministic counts (candidate rotations, retired instructions), and are all three exact?
convention: bit i = normal-basis coefficient i; rotl(x,s) = ((x<<s)|(x>>(131-s))) & (2^131-1); canonical = (min_s rotl(x,s), least such s); identical to canonical_gap at n=83 and least_rotation

justification: x86-64 has no 128-bit general-purpose registers: a u128 is lowered to two u64 registers anyway, so u128 + top limb is the same three registers with the cross-limb carries hidden in compiler lowering of 128-bit shifts (variable u128 shifts lower to shld/shl plus a test of bit 6 and cmov), which makes the branch-free property harder to audit
explicit limbs let one generic code path run with any limb width B, so the three-limb carries and the wrap from bit 130 to bit 0 are tested exhaustively at small n with small limbs (tests/small_n.rs)
it is the host layout of cryptanalysis:ecc2k130/src/f131.h (struct F131 { uint64_t w[3]; }, 64/64/3), so a canonicalizer here drops into that walk without a repack

arms.exhaustive: (a) reference: N-1 rotate-by-one steps, keep first strict minimum (ties -> smallest shift)
arms.gap_scan: (b) zero-gap set-bit scan: ctz over the set bits of the three limbs, cyclic gap between consecutive ones, rotate-and-compare at every gap >= running maximum, wrap gap last; constant words return (x,0)
arms.refine_bf: (c) branch-free: bit-parallel candidate refinement. Candidate mask C (start positions), B_t = rotl(x,t); for t in 0..130: C' = C & ~B_t, C = C' if C' != 0 else C, by mask select. Fixed 130 steps; the first Z steps are the zero-run growth of the lemma. Shift = 130 - msb(C) by branch-free per-limb lzcnt/bsr and mask select; word = fixed 8-stage masked barrel rotation. Constant words fall out with shift 0 without a special case.
arms.exhaustive_bf: supplementary: (a) with a borrow-chain compare and mask selects (scalar analogue of the paper's vectorized variant C)
arms.lift_scan: supplementary: variant A analogue: branch-free binary lifting (constant rotations only) of the longest-run mask, then a data-dependent loop over its set bits
arms.null: call/copy overhead reference for instruction counts

branch_free_definition: In the arm's machine code (objdump, Intel syntax), every conditional jump is a backward loop edge whose flags come from a counter register that is initialised by a constant and stepped only by constants inside the loop; no call, no indirect jump; selections by and/andn/or masks or cmov. Checked mechanically by asm_check.py on the built bench binary. Memory accesses are only the fixed loads of the input and stores of the output. Not claimed: constant time on any particular microarchitecture (no timing-leak test is run).

build.target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, baseline x86-64 (no target-cpu flag; pclmulqdq only inside the fmul proxy behind target_feature)
build.profile: opt-level 3, codegen-units 1, fat LTO, panic abort, debug=1 symbols

exactness.small_n: every word for n = 2..20 in two geometries (three limbs of ceil(n/3) bits; one 64-bit limb) plus n = 8, 12, 20 with an empty top limb; every arm vs exhaustive vs an independent u64 oracle; composite n included for ties (cargo test --release)
n131_edges: x in F_2: 0 and all-ones (1 in a normal basis); expected (x, 0) from every arm
every word of weight 1, 2, 3 and its complement (weights 128-130)
one zero run of length 1..60 straddling bit 64, bit 128 or the wrap 130->0 at every offset; with all-ones background, with a second equal run (tie), and on 4 random backgrounds
exactly c tied longest runs of length z, c = 2..12, z = 1..12, up to 200 words each
near-periodic words: random pattern of period 2..40 over 131 bits, 0-2 random flips, 1000 per period

oracle.check: exhaustive arm vs a Vec<bool> oracle with no limb code; and the minimizing shift is unique for every nonconstant word (Corollary cor:unique)

distributions.structured: random pattern of period d uniform in 2..20 repeated over 131 bits, one random flip with probability 1/2 (structured131 in src/lib.rs); a stress distribution with many tied longest runs, not a model of any workload

counts.reported: mean, sd, median, max and histogram of: longest zero run Z; number c of longest runs (= candidate rotations of variant A / lift_scan); gap-scan rotate-and-compare evaluations; refinement depth (steps until one candidate); fraction of nonconstant words with c = 1

tool_order: perf stat -e instructions (try; record if unavailable)
instructions.unit: retired instructions (Ir) of the arm's own symbol canon131_<arm> per word, from cg_annotate; the arms are leaf functions (asm_check confirms no call), so self Ir = inclusive Ir; the null arm's Ir is reported as call overhead
instructions.both_distributions: every arm on both; a branch-free arm must have identical Ir per word on both

metrics.field_multiply_reference: crypto has no 131-bit normal-basis multiply (koblitz_rotated_chain ONB requires m < 128; cyclotomic_factor_base n <= 62). As a labelled proxy only, Ir of one 131-bit polynomial-basis multiply mod z^131+z^13+z^2+z+1 (PCLMULQDQ schoolbook + word reduction, checked against bitwise schoolbook), 200000 chained products, seed 7003. Ratio canon Ir / fmul Ir. A point operation costs several multiplies plus a conversion; no point-operation ratio is claimed.
metrics.wall_clock: exploratory, UNISOLATED cloud VM, no isolation receipt: 1,000,000 words per arm per distribution (seeds 9001 uniform, 9002 structured), 11 passes, median ns/word, arms run in the fixed order exhaustive, gap_scan, refine_bf, exhaustive_bf, lift_scan, null, fmul. Not a speedup claim under AGENTS.md CPU tiers.

predictions.P2: gap_scan mean rotations per uniform word between 4 and 6.5 (4.78 at n = 83)
predictions.P3: fraction of uniform words with one longest run between 0.65 and 0.78 (72.6% at n = 61)
predictions.P4: refine_bf and exhaustive_bf retire identical Ir per word on both distributions
predictions.P5: refine_bf costs more Ir per uniform word than gap_scan, by at least 3x
predictions.P6: max refinement depth on uniform words is far below 130, while the structured distribution reaches depth > 100, which is why a fixed-count branch-free arm cannot stop at the zero-gap filter

claims_not_made: no wall-clock speedup; no end-to-end or ECDLP claim; no constant-time certification; the fmul ratio is a proxy, not a point-operation ratio
